properties.displayName: QC - D - Detect NPPSpy registry modification
properties.description:
This query detects suspicious PowerShell cmdlets used to modify the registry associated with NPPSpy password stealer
attack. An attacker may create a rogue network logon provider module for credential access via registry by intercepting
the authentication credentials in clear text during user logon. A "High" Integrity Level is required to dump credentials
successfully. Advanced adversaries may change the name of the DLL or modify the source code to perform the credential
dumping attack
References:
- https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1003/
- https://github.com/gtworek/PSBits/tree/master/PasswordStealing/NPPSpy
properties.query:
let TimeFrame = 1h;
let NPPSpyIoCSearch = 
(union isfuzzy=true
(DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has "ImageLoaded"
| where InitiatingProcessParentFileName has "winlogon.exe"
| where FileName matches regex "NPPSPY.dll"
| where FolderPath has "C:\\Windows\\System32"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "mpnotify.exe"
| summarize InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), 
              InitiatingProcessFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName), FileName = make_set(FileName), FolderPath = make_set(FolderPath),
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath = make_set(InitiatingProcessFolderPath), InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), 
              InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), 
              count() by DeviceName,  InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
| project-reorder DeviceName, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, 
                InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, FolderPath,
                InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId,
                InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel 
),(DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType has "FileCreated"
| where FileName has "NPPSPY.dll"
| where FileSize == 134997
| summarize InitiatingProcessParentFileName = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentFileName), FileName = make_set(FileName), FolderPath = make_set(FolderPath),
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), 
          InitiatingProcessParentId = make_set(InitiatingProcessParentId), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), 
          count() by DeviceName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName,  InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
| project-reorder DeviceName, ActionType, 
                  InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessParentFileName, FileName, FolderPath,
                  InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessParentId, InitiatingProcessId, 
                  InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel
),(DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(TimeFrame)
| where ActionType in ("RegistryKeyCreated","RegistryValueSet")
| where RegistryKey startswith "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE" and RegistryKey has "SYSTEM\\ControlSet001\\Control\\NetworkProvider\\Order"
| where InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel has "High"
| where RegistryValueName has "PROVIDERORDER"
| where RegistryValueData contains "NPPSpy"
| summarize ActionType = make_set(ActionType), 
              RegistryValueData = make_set(RegistryValueData), PreviousRegistryKey = make_set(PreviousRegistryKey), PreviousRegistryValueData = make_set(PreviousRegistryValueData),
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine  = make_set(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), InitiatingProcessId = make_set(InitiatingProcessId), 
              count() by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName, RegistryKey
| project-reorder DeviceName, ActionType, 
              RegistryKey, RegistryValueData, PreviousRegistryKey, PreviousRegistryValueData,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessId,
              InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain, InitiatingProcessAccountName
)); NPPSpyIoCSearch
